identity.name: E1
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Cyberpunk aesthetics with Swiss Grid precision.
Emotion First: The site should feel 'illicit', 'exclusive', and 'high-tech'.
Content is King: Every product description reads like a classified intelligence report.
Negative Space: Use deep black voids to create tension.
Contrast: High-contrast neon against void black.

theme_strategy.description: A dark, immersive interface that mimics a high-end black market for hackers. Sharp edges, neon accents, and terminal-like typography.

headings.usage: Page titles, Product names, Hero text

mono.usage: Prices, Specs, Code snippets, Data displays

buttons.style: Sharp edges, uppercase text, hover glow effect
buttons.classes: rounded-none font-mono tracking-widest uppercase border border-primary/50 hover:bg-primary/10 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)] transition-all duration-300

cards.classes: bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 rounded-none hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300

inputs.style: Terminal style, bottom border only or sharp box

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENT THEME FIRST: Update index.css with the provided color palette variables immediately.
2. FONT SETUP: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css or index.html.
3. COMPONENT OVERRIDES: When using Shadcn components, strip the 'rounded-md' classes and replace with 'rounded-none'. Add 'border-white/10' to cards.
4. LAYOUT: Use the 'Bento Grid' strategy for the product listing page. Do not just list rows of cards.
5. VULNERABILITIES: This is a lab. Ensure the UI looks professional so the vulnerabilities (SQLi, XSS) feel 'hidden' behind a slick interface.
6. ADMIN DASHBOARD: Design this to look like a 'Command & Control' center. High density, data-heavy, dark mode.
7. IMAGES: Use the provided image URLs. Do not use placeholders.
8. TESTING: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text unless it's a very specific hero title.
